label: 038 close-price forecast study: pre-registered pass rule (specs/038-close-forecast-study, research R8-R9)
target: log return of close over N candles; trades long-only, entry open[t+1], exit open[t+1+N]
eligibility: entry and exit candles have volume > 0 and exist in the raw file

selection.signal: f > 0 and f >= causal 0.9 quantile of the pair/method/N's previous 30 days of forecasts

benchmark: pair- and half-matched mean gross trade return of all eligible scored candles (random entry)

hist_mean.params: f[n] = n x mean 1-candle log return of the pair over all data before the fold start

ar.params: AutoReg, lags by ar_select_order(maxlag=15); forecast path summed

lgb_L.features: L: log returns over 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,96; realised vol 16, 96; log volume ratio 16/96

lgb_LA.features: L + 24 ARO model inputs (037 cache base: columns aliased by aro:)

lgb_LW.features: L + SWT bior3.9 level-2 coefficients at the last position (cA2, cD2, cD1) + FFT magnitudes bins 1-8, on the trailing 64 1-candle log returns; only inputs passing the truncation test

lightgbm_params.training: anchored from 2021-01-01 to test_start minus (N+1) candles, pooled pairs, training rows at stride 4; rows need eligible, has_data and data_ok

decision.PASS (PROVISIONAL): all of: (a) n_trades >= 200 in each half; (b) mean_net at verdict_bps > 0 in each half; (c) edge_vs_rand > 0 in each half; (d) late-half one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound of mean_net at verdict_bps > 0; (e) learned methods (tiers 2-3): the seed-2 rerun also meets (a)-(d)
decision.FAIL: mean_net at verdict_bps <= 0 in either half, or edge_vs_rand <= 0 in either half (when that half has trades)
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, including fewer than 200 trades in a half, or fail_share > max_fail_share
decision.null_downgrade: if lgb_null PASSes at any N, every tier-2/3 PASS becomes INCONCLUSIVE
decision.provisional: no distant era exists (binance.com data empty); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2)

summary.most_viable_n: N of the PASS cell with the highest late-half net_per_pair_year at verdict_bps; null if no PASS
summary.break_even_n: smallest N at which any non-null method has mean_net at verdict_bps > 0 in both halves; null if none

instrument: SC-002b lgb_null is not PASS at any N
